control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at ZV-7212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on ZV-7212 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. ZV-7212 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 15 May 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on ZV-7212 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a statutory inspection; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
